Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Hema - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vimla - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan reads a storybook.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan writes in his notebook.]

Ishaan (gently): "What happened?"

[Ishaan does his homework at the table.]

Ishaan (laughing): "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan types on his laptop.]

Ishaan (excited): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Riya and Hema stand near him.]

Riya: "Ishaan, look over here."

[Ishaan searches for his lost ball.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan carries his school bag on his back.]

Ishaan: "What next?"

[Riya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Riya: "One more time!"

[Ishaan trips over a stone.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan milks the cow.]

Ishaan: "That was such a fun day!"
